_about.table: audio quirks matched against the HDAUDIO and INTELAUDIO device paths
_about.fields: Match (a regular expression over the device path, case does not matter), Name, MinKernel, Status, Note, Source, Verified

Quirks.Name: Cirrus Logic CS35L41 smart amplifier
Quirks.Note: Laptop speakers are driven by Cirrus smart amps. Headphones work immediately; internal speakers stay silent until kernel 6.7+ with the right firmware. Very common on ASUS, Dell and Lenovo 2023+ models.

Quirks.Name: Cirrus Logic CS35L56 smart amplifier
Quirks.Note: Laptop speakers are driven by Cirrus smart amps. Headphones work immediately; internal speakers may stay silent until kernel 6.7+ with vendor firmware extracted from Windows.

Quirks.Name: TI TAS2781 smart amplifier
Quirks.Note: TI smart amps, common on Lenovo. Internal speakers need kernel 6.6+ and firmware; headphones are unaffected.

Quirks.Name: Intel SST / SOF DSP audio
Quirks.Note: DSP-based audio. Needs the SOF firmware package, which most current distros ship - but audio may be silent on older or minimal installs.
